diagnosis: Export job running well past the expected duration; treat as stalled.
reply: As a premium support customer, your ticket has been placed in the priority queue. Export jobs of this size normally finish within an hour, and a job that reports running for more than six hours has stalled. Please cancel the job and resubmit it; if the resubmitted job also stalls, reply here with the new job id and we will investigate the regional queue. See "Data export jobs: expected duration and stalls" (kb-0005) for the full details.
